audit_findings.defect: Binance Vision monthly fundingRate CSV column offset (row[1]=8 instead of row[2]=last_funding_rate) produced phantom 800% funding rates.
audit_findings.remediation: Corrected index parsing to row[2] for funding_rate and row[1] for interval hours. Rebuilt funding tables.

audit_findings.defect: Backtester divided cumulative multi-trade P&L by capital of first trade only, producing 631,000% RoC.
audit_findings.remediation: Implemented PortfolioEquityEngine with discrete time-series equity curve, FIXED_NOTIONAL sizing, and daily Sharpe.

audit_findings.defect: Arbitrary fixed 1.0 BTC sizing and hardcoded asset='BTC' across all candidates; flat $2 legging delay loss.
audit_findings.remediation: Implemented dynamic notional sizing ($50,000/leg), genuine ETH carry, and proportional bps legging model.

audit_findings.defect: STRUCT_C1 used BTC spot-perp episode accounting while referencing eth_dev[i] during validation period.
audit_findings.remediation: Implemented RelativePerpPairEpisode with 2 perp legs and strict timestamp join on ts_event_ns.

audit_findings.defect: Perp observations could be taken from future timestamps if spot hour preceded perp index.
audit_findings.remediation: Exact-hour grouping and strict equality perp_hour_ts == spot_hour_ts.

audit_findings.defect: Silent fallback substitutions: perp close for mark, spot close for index, 0.0 for premium.
audit_findings.remediation: Removed all fallback substitutions. Implemented FAIL_CLOSED_NO_FALLBACK policy and explicit availability booleans.

audit_findings.defect: Status was hardcoded to REJECTED with empty rejection_reasons=[].
audit_findings.remediation: Dynamic policy evaluation returning PRELIMINARY_PASS or REJECTED with mandatory rejection reasons.

audit_findings.defect: Round 3 verifier checked only basic file existence without testing mathematical invariants or sanity limits.
audit_findings.remediation: Created tools/verify_research_round3a.py with 11 strict economic, provenance, and accounting gates.

audit_findings.defect: Documentation discrepancy between premiumIndexKlines and premiumPriceKlines.
audit_findings.remediation: Direct HEAD verification confirmed premiumIndexKlines is 200 OK and premiumPriceKlines is 404.
